observations.why: The causal framing presents the gate as a consequence imposed in response to prior failures, but does not establish a distinctive reusable node.
The performed gate establishes a mandatory permission condition for deploys, enacting authority-ranking.
The scope statement extends the same governing condition across deployment contexts, reinforcing a ranked governance relation.
Naming an owner assigns governance responsibility through role and rank, directly enacting authority-ranking.
